dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: We must remain focused. The Wild Hunt could return any moment.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: The Wild Hunt here is unlike its cousins in other places, and is all the more dangerous for it. Let your guard down for even just a moment, and its punishment will be swift.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Though we now know what they're capable of, they can still get us at any time.

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: Three years ago, my older brother was caught completely off guard by them during an investigation. Thankfully, he survived thanks to his teammates...

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: In short, when it comes to them, we must remain focused at all times.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Illuga</color> looks like he has something to say...?)

dialogues.speaker: Illuga
dialogues.text: Alright, is there anything in particular I should know about?

dialogues.speaker: Rollon
dialogues.text: No, sir. There's nothing you need to worry about for now. You can leave this to us.
